scope: All272 priority_early_industry buckets assigned to systemic/hematology/immune plus all2010–2024 industry-linked HAE/PNH buckets, including later-phase discovery aliases. Finite panel subset, not whole drug-development universe.
limits: All candidate IDs have an auditable disposition; mapping completeness is not historical program-universe completeness.
Most non-HAE/PNH programs have registry identity review only; external outcome research unfinished.
Healthy-volunteer starts omitted by disease search and later-indication/combination entries can bias denominator.
Approval endpoint must be specified: China-only approval is not FDA success.
Closed-case success fractions would be upward biased by selective outcome resolution and right censoring.
No fitted lifetime probability or unbiased broad PoS estimate is claimed.
